name: const unsafe fn size_of_val_raw < T : ? Sized > (val : * const T) -> usize
rule: If the unsized tail of T is a slice, the size of the entire value, including the dynamic tail and statically sized prefix, must fit in isize, except when the dynamic tail length is 0.
api: const unsafe fn size_of_val_raw < T : ? Sized > (val : * const T) -> usize
